headline: PANORAMA paper introduces dense phrase-to-pixel captioning and PanoCaps benchmark
summary: Pieri et al. introduce PanoCaps, a human-annotated benchmark for full-scene captions with phrase-level pixel masks, and PANORAMA, which grounds each caption phrase by selecting from phrase-conditioned proposals generated by a pretrained segmenter. The authors report 3,470 images, 34.1K masks and 99.1% overall referenced-pixel coverage. They report strong results on PanoCaps and several related grounding tasks, including 75.5 overall gIoU on GroundingSuite versus 67.8 for the highest listed prior result. These are paper-reported evaluations; the research desk did not run the released code or model.
